title: pipeline_rejection
description: Pipeline rejection record — emitted by lib/pipeline_synthesizer.py::reject_synthesis when a staged pipeline is discarded (user rejected, meta-skill abandoned the staging). Replaces the v2.0 pattern of re-emitting a pipeline_synthesis record with validation_status='invalid' (Pitfall 2 hack — rejection is not a validation failure). CLEAN-09 / v2.0 Phase 5 REVIEW MR-02.

rejected_slug.description: Slug of the staged pipeline that was rejected — filename stem (no .yaml). The file under _staging/<slug>.yaml has been unlinked by the time this record is emitted.

staging_path.description: Repo-relative path where the staged YAML used to live (pipeline_defs/_staging/<slug>.yaml). Included for audit trail — the file itself is gone.

reason.description: Optional free-text human-provided reason for rejection (not recorded by this version; meta-skill may forward it in a future phase).
